[head=1][color=#FFEF00]Introduction[/head][/color]
[color=#FFFACD]Triad is an 18+ roleplay server, with a focus on providing a place for players to roleplay in a mature environment. This has the allowance of sexual activities to happen, but this does not mean the priority of the server is erotic content.[/color]
We recommend keeping the game at an arms length. Healthy distance between yourself and roleplay is essential for maintaining In Character (IC) and Out of Character (OOC) separation. Do not interfere with your physical or mental health by overcommitting to a game too heavily.
It's easy to get immersed in what's happening or invested in your characters' story and their successes. This is not an MMO to grind, this is a place to make and tell stories. Loss and setbacks are part of those stories. Try to tell your character's story of overcoming them instead of reacting negatively to a game.
[bold]Please make sure to also read [textlink="the lore primer" link="BasicLore"] to better understand your character's circumstances and context to the round.[/bold]
[color=#a4885c][head=2]Clarifications[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.[/color] Rules are intended to be enforced as written, with no unwritten or hidden rules; should a conflict with interpretation of rules as written occur; regardless of outcome of prompting action: the ambiguous rule will be re-written to be futureproofed. These rules are intended as a promise made to our players regarding other players and staff conduct. Which can be used to reasonably set expectations.
[color=#a4885c]2.[/color] Rules bind staff and players alike; while there is some discretion for staff breaches when pursued in the interest of the current round, server, or community at large; any such instance will be investigated.
[color=#a4885c]3.[/color] Our goal is to create a community that allows you freedom to play a character you want. We may play evil or villainous characters, but that does not mean we are. Talk to each other OOC if there are issues, and work towards telling a story everyone enjoys.
[color=#a4885c]4.[/color] aHelp is intended for immediate term communication and interventions; issues requiring broader discussion or appeals for any aHelp action are to be relegated to tickets.
[color=#a4885c]5.[/color] All tickets can be adjudicated either privately in a ticket or publicly via the discord. Ticket transcripts will be sent to you upon their conclusion.
[color=#a4885c]6.[/color] LTAP (leaving to avoid punishment) by disconnecting, ignoring admin messages or otherwise will result in an appeal-only ban.
[color=#a4885c]7.[/color] Administration, like yourselves, are roleplayers, and want to help you in telling stories. You can always aHelp to ask for assistance with character modifications, trinkets or other things that facilitate roleplay scenarios. We're happy to work with you to tell your character's story.
[color=#FFFACD]If you have any questions about these rules, please use the Admin help menu by hitting [/italic][color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenAHelp"/][/bold][/color] in-game, or clicking the "aHelp" button in the lobby, or alternatively, ask for assistance on the discord.[/color]
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Severity guidelines:[/head][/color]
• ★ / Minor infraction
•[color=#f1c232]★★[/color] / Major infraction
•[color=#cc0000]★★★[/color] / Extreme infraction
# Core Rules These rules apply at all times, including between rounds.
Rules are broken down into three categories. OOC interactions: How you interact with other players who are playing the game outside of roleplay.
IC interactions: How your character interacts with other characters in roleplay.
Mechanical interactions: How you interact with the mechanics and systems within the server.
Extreme/Erotic interactions: Where, how and what to do regarding extreme/erotic content on the server.
